goal: Make Landing, marketing routes, Admin, and Demo tell one coherent product story with consistent sample data and state transitions
context: Run after the core route, Admin, and Demo slices pass individually. The project has no live backend, so the review must keep simulated data explicit while making the prototype feel intentionally connected.
requirements: Create one canonical sample scenario for customer, products, stock, conversation, lead score, handoff, and order state
Align terminology, prices, SKU values, channel names, status labels, timestamps, and actions across all routes
Make cross-route CTAs preserve user intent and explain what changes when moving from marketing proof to demo or workspace
Remove contradictory claims, dead-end actions, duplicate concepts, and unsupported metrics
acceptance_criteria: A reviewer can follow one scenario from Landing proof through Demo qualification into Admin context without contradictions
All simulated values are labeled consistently and no screen implies a live integration or backend action
Primary navigation and CTA destinations preserve context and do not create meaningless page changes
An end-to-end route and interaction sweep is recorded with no P0/P1 continuity defect
